decision_rule: Only requirements marked proved with current authoritative evidence may be claimed complete. partial, gap, blocked, or unverified keeps the thread goal active.

audit_items.requirement: Report Studio must keep the original Red Team analysis and add an independent Korean beginner-facing RedTeam AX v2 workbench as 레드팀 분석2.
audit_items.proof_summary: Tab registry exposes 레드팀 분석 and 레드팀 분석2; browser smoke checks reportStudio, redteamAnalysis, redteamAnalysis2, Korean body text, and RedTeam AX v2 markers. RedTeam2 includes read-only OpenVAS/ZAP service import and runtime readiness panels wired to v2 APIs.
audit_items.next_action: Continue UI coverage only when new panels are added.

audit_items.requirement: Frontend user-facing RedTeam AX content must be Korean and understandable to non-expert operators.
audit_items.proof_summary: Recent slices localize ToolActionCard, scanner guidance, runner, sanitizer, visual evidence, file upload, RBAC, service import, runtime readiness, live readiness runbook step visibility, role/severity/status displays and smoke validates koreanDisplayMapping. The static Korean visible-copy inventory now checks RedTeam2 panel literals, beginner guidance anchors including read-only service import, Docker/OpenVAS/ZAP runtime blocker copy, operator remediation step copy, allowed technical terms, disallowed English-only execution phrases, and English-only ratio.
audit_items.next_action: Run the RedTeam2 Korean copy inventory sanity when UI copy changes.

audit_items.requirement: Cases must operate through ROE, HITL, guardrails, and ToolActionCard before any tool/script/MCP/LLM-agent action.
audit_items.proof_summary: API tests cover health policy, ROE deny, high-risk ToolAction HITL, approval queue, actor-bound approval, T4/T5 controls, and manual-run invalid without ToolActionCard.
audit_items.next_action: Keep regression cases mandatory for future execution changes.

audit_items.requirement: Only approved tools, scripts, MCP, and LLM agents may be used; direct MCP/tool invocation must be denied by default.
audit_items.proof_summary: v2 API enforces ToolAction and approval controls for exposed routes, and /api/redteam/v2/mcp/direct-invoke now returns a non-executing deny guard with commands_executed_by_api=false, mcp_server_invoked=false, trusted_as_instruction=false, and artifact evidence.
audit_items.next_action: Keep the MCP direct invocation denial regression in the v2 API suite when adding real MCP gateway integrations.

audit_items.requirement: Nuclei, OpenVAS, Trivy, SCA, npm audit, and OWASP ZAP must be registered, selectable, safety-classified, and routed to LLM analysis agents.
audit_items.proof_summary: API registry exposes all six tools and six analysis agents; tests validate required tool names, agent IDs, trust policy, normalizers, frontend ToolHub selection, and governed multi-toolchain execution routing for multiple installed tool steps.
audit_items.next_action: Tie future tool additions to the registry/agent contract test.

audit_items.requirement: Tool installation integration and version-command evidence must be available for the scanner toolchain.
audit_items.proof_summary: Install-readiness registry returns operator-run install plans, /api/redteam/v2/tool-install-readiness/{tool_id}/version-evidence records operator-attested version evidence, and /api/redteam/v2/toolchains/execute-governed routes multiple installed-tool runner steps through existing execution tokens and wrapper gates.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves governed evidence capture and multi-tool orchestration contract, not that real scanner binaries or containers have run successfully in the local environment; runtime smoke remains tracked by RTA-COMP-015.
audit_items.next_action: Run a host-specific live smoke with installed tools or a ready container runner and attach artifact.

audit_items.requirement: Every material artifact, image, log, tool result, and analysis judgment must flow into Evidence Card and Claim-Evidence Matrix tracking.
audit_items.proof_summary: Sample E2E covers manual artifacts, raw imports, normalization, Evidence Card creation/approval, Finding link, report validation, and Claim-Evidence Matrix report section.
audit_items.next_action: Add new artifact types to the same evidence path instead of bypassing it.

audit_items.requirement: High-risk execution must be human approved, human performed or reviewed, and AI must remain planner/evidence/analyzer/report-draft assistant.
audit_items.proof_summary: Tests and live smoke preserve commands_executed_by_api=false for unsafe flows, require approvals and uploaded artifacts, and block runner paths before required gates.
audit_items.next_action: Maintain no-runner invariant in live smoke when adding new browser actions.

audit_items.requirement: Korean Red Team Report v2 must combine Volkis-style Campaign Walkthrough with malware-report-style document control and evidence forms.
audit_items.proof_summary: Sample E2E generated report contains 문서 통제, Campaign Walkthrough, Claim-Evidence Matrix, zero gate counts, export approval block, executive approval, and exported artifact.
audit_items.next_action: Add visual regression for report preview only if report rendering UI changes.

audit_items.requirement: Agentic RAG canonical requirements must support SCA sufficient context, corpus routing, citation verifier, and unsupported claim hold.
audit_items.proof_summary: API tests cover approved-evidence SCA sufficiency, retrieve-again when claims lack approved evidence, report metadata persistence, and hold audit for unsupported claims.
audit_items.next_action: Keep Agentic RAG SPEC as canonical for future RAG changes.

audit_items.requirement: Red Team Studio folder, previous work index, and ChatShare transcript must be LLM-wiki indexed and callable.
audit_items.proof_summary: LLM wiki home links local manifest, top-dir/extension summaries, previous work index, and complete public ChatShare extraction package.
audit_items.next_action: Add qmd/kdq or graph index integration if downstream tooling requires it.

audit_items.requirement: All tests, security gates, sample case E2E, report verification, and regression checks must pass before final completion.
audit_items.proof_summary: Accepted gate manifest now enumerates and executes the current full accepted gate set: v2 API regression, sample E2E/report gate with zero-count assertions, completion audit sanity, plan contract sanity, Korean copy inventory, installed-tool live smoke, scanner CLI smoke, OpenVAS/ZAP CLI smoke, OpenVAS/ZAP service import smoke, frontend service import contract, frontend runtime readiness contract, external scanner readiness, external scanner service import live harness, WSL runtime readiness, strict live readiness promotion, live readiness remediation runbook, operator evidence collection package, operator evidence submission validation, operator Evidence Card import plan, tool result analysis brief, tool result finding/claim review, Python compile, frontend JS check, and frontend build.
audit_items.next_action: Keep this accepted gate manifest mandatory after future RedTeam AX code, UI, report, or audit changes.

audit_items.requirement: Final gate must prove unsupported claim, unapproved high-risk execution, and evidence-less Finding counts are all zero.
audit_items.proof_summary: Report validation tests block non-zero counts and sample E2E verifies zero unsupported_claim, unapproved_high_risk, finding_without_evidence, unapproved evidence/finding/severity before export.
audit_items.next_action: Use this gate as final objective audit input, not as sole proof of unrelated install/runtime requirements.

audit_items.requirement: OpenVAS and ZAP API credential vault and read-only token policy must exist for scanner integration.
audit_items.proof_summary: OpenVAS and ZAP now have credential policy registry and authorization APIs that accept only external vault references, enforce read-only token scopes, deny submitted secret material, require actor-bound red_team_lead/control_team approval, and expose Korean RedTeam2 UI panels for read-only authorization and scanner service report import.
audit_items.next_action: Keep credential authorization regression mandatory when wiring live OpenVAS/ZAP API adapters.

audit_items.requirement: Actual CLI/container runtime smoke must prove governed runtime readiness where applicable.
audit_items.proof_summary: Installed npm audit, Nuclei, Trivy, OpenVAS gvm-cli, and OWASP ZAP CLI wrapper paths were exercised through the governed runner using low-risk metadata commands. Nuclei v3.10.0 and Trivy v0.72.0 were installed as checksum-verified portable official release binaries; OpenVAS/ZAP wrappers run from an isolated tools/redteam-ax venv via hash-pinned .cmd shims. Each passed ToolActionCard, ExecutionPlan, wrapper pin, execution token, child-process allowlist, shell=false execution, sanitizer, agent normalization, and Evidence Card creation. OpenVAS XML and ZAP JSON service report import has a read-only endpoint adapter smoke using authorized external vault references, local HTTP report endpoints, sanitizer, tool-specific parser, agent normalization, Evidence Card creation, negative secret-material rejection, and RedTeam2 frontend panels for import plus runtime readiness visibility. The external scanner service import live harness now uses organization endpoint/vault envs, backend credential authorization, backend scanner-service-import API, and negative secret-material controls when --allow-network is explicitly enabled. WSL runtime readiness now records WSL distribution listing/start blockers or ready tool paths without active scans. Strict live readiness promotion rolls up Docker real container, WSL ready, external scanner readiness, and external scanner import live gates into one promotion artifact. Live readiness remediation runbook converts the current promotion blockers into owner/action/verification/evidence steps. Operator evidence collection package converts those runbook steps into Evidence Card candidate submission items with expected attachment statuses and no command or secret collection. Operator evidence submission validation checks submitted artifact path, SHA-256, expected status, and human approval without command execution. Operator Evidence Card import plan converts approved/verified submission items into pending-review Evidence Card candidate payloads and Claim-Evidence Matrix hints without creating cards automatically. Tool result analysis brief groups governed npm audit, Nuclei, Trivy, OpenVAS, and ZAP results into an Evidence pack, SCA-style sufficiency report, Claim-Evidence Matrix candidates, and tool-specific LLM analyst limits. Tool result finding/claim review package converts that Evidence pack into pending Finding payloads and Claim candidates while holding report insertion until Evidence and severity approvals are complete. RedTeam2 now renders those steps, evidence collection items, submission validation items, Evidence Card import candidates, tool result analysis brief, finding/claim review package, and fallback operator ordering in Korean. Current Docker, WSL, and external scanner readiness/import/promotion/remediation/evidence-package/submission-validation/import-plan artifacts preserve the remaining blockers in machine-readable form, and /api/redteam/v2/runtime-readiness exposes them without executing Docker or scanner commands.
audit_items.residual_gap: Docker/container runtime live smoke is not successful in this environment because Docker CLI is installed but the daemon reports unable to start. WSL readiness currently records blocked_wsl_distribution_start_failed for Ubuntu-22.04. OpenVAS/ZAP service import contract is proved against controlled local read-only endpoints, and organization endpoint live import harness exists; actual organization OpenVAS/ZAP read-only report endpoints and external vault refs are not configured in this environment. Strict live readiness promotion currently records blocked_strict_live_readiness_promotion, the remediation runbook records blocked operator steps, the operator evidence package records blocked collection items, the submission validator records awaiting operator evidence submission, and the Evidence Card import plan records awaiting approved operator evidence.
audit_items.next_action: Follow latest_live_readiness_remediation_runbook.md and latest_operator_evidence_collection_package.md to prepare Docker, WSL, OpenVAS/ZAP endpoints, vault refs, and attach reviewed evidence artifacts. Then run redteam_ax_operator_evidence_submission_validator.py --submission-manifest <path> --require-approved, redteam_ax_operator_evidence_card_import_plan.py --require-ready, create/review Evidence Cards from the candidate payloads, run redteam_ax_live_readiness_remediation_runbook.py --require-clear, and run redteam_ax_strict_live_readiness_promotion.py --allow-container --allow-network --require-promotion.

audit_items.requirement: Completion audit itself must remain machine-checkable and prevent accidental goal-complete claims while gaps remain.
audit_items.proof_summary: The matrix declares goal_status active_incomplete, contains proved and unresolved statuses, and is validated by a sanity test.
audit_items.next_action: Update this matrix after each future slice until unresolved statuses reach zero with authoritative evidence.

audit_items.requirement: Multiple governed scanner/tool results must be available as an LLM/RAG-consumable evidence analysis brief without treating raw tool output as instructions.
audit_items.proof_summary: The brief reads latest governed npm audit, Nuclei, Trivy, OpenVAS, and OWASP ZAP artifacts, keeps only run/result/evidence-linked results in evidence_pack, records blocked items separately, emits SCA-style sufficiency and Claim-Evidence Matrix candidates, sets llm_raw_tool_output_trusted=false, and exposes tool analyst agent allowed/prohibited actions in the Korean RedTeam2 runtime panel.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves evidence analysis packaging, not that every candidate has been promoted into approved Findings or final report claims.
audit_items.next_action: Use approved Evidence Cards and analyst review to promote brief candidates into Findings and Report v2 claims.

audit_items.requirement: Tool result evidence candidates must be convertible into human-reviewed Finding draft payloads and held report claim candidates before final report use.
audit_items.proof_summary: The review package reads the tool result analysis brief, creates Finding draft payloads and Claim candidates per Evidence-linked tool result, preserves finding_created=false and report_claim_inserted=false, and holds candidates until Evidence Card approval and two-person Finding severity approval are complete. RedTeam2 shows the package and held candidate count in Korean.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves pre-promotion packaging, not actual Finding creation, severity approval, or report claim insertion.
audit_items.next_action: After Evidence Cards are approved, create Findings through /api/redteam/v2/findings, complete severity approvals, and regenerate the report gate with zero unsupported claim and evidence-less Finding counts.

audit_items.requirement: Tool result Finding/Claim review candidates must have a governed API path that blocks unapproved evidence and creates only pending-review Findings after Evidence Card approval.
audit_items.proof_summary: The v2 API exposes the latest Finding/Claim review package and a per-candidate promote-finding endpoint. Promotion blocks when Evidence is not approved, ignores force flags, never inserts report claims, and only calls the existing create_finding path when backend Evidence store approval is present. API tests cover listing, blocked promotion, and approved-evidence pending-review Finding creation.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the governed promotion API path, not that all real operating candidates have approved Evidence Cards, two-person severity approvals, or final report claim validation.
audit_items.next_action: Use the promotion API after actual Evidence Card approval, then complete severity approvals and report validation for each real tool result candidate.

audit_items.requirement: Tool result Finding/Claim review candidates must have a governed Claim-Evidence Matrix draft API that only forwards approved Evidence and two-person-approved Findings to report validation preview.
audit_items.proof_summary: The matrix-draft API builds per-candidate Claim-Evidence rows from the tool result Finding/Claim review package, holds rows until Evidence Card approval and two-person Finding severity approval are complete, includes only ready rows in report_validation_payload_preview, and runs the existing report validation gate only when ready rows exist. API tests cover both held and ready paths.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves guarded report-validation staging for selected candidates, not that every real operating candidate has been approved or that the final Korean report has been generated from all real tool results.
audit_items.next_action: After real Evidence approvals and Finding severity approvals, run matrix-draft for all candidates and then generate/validate the final report with zero blockers.

audit_items.requirement: Approved Matrix draft rows must have a governed path into Korean Red Team Report v2 draft generation while held rows continue to block report generation.
audit_items.proof_summary: The matrix-draft/report-draft API first creates a Matrix draft, blocks report generation when no ready rows exist or held rows remain, and calls the existing Korean Report v2 generator only when the Matrix validation preview passes. API tests cover held-row blocking and ready-row report draft generation with Claim-Evidence Matrix sections.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the controlled report-draft lane for selected ready candidates, not real operating completion across all tool result candidates or final export approval.
audit_items.next_action: Run the report-draft API only after all real operating candidates have approved Evidence, promoted Findings, two-person severity approvals, and Matrix draft ready status.

audit_items.requirement: Governed multi-toolchain execution must have a result collection API that reads stored runner artifacts, sanitizes untrusted output, runs tool-specific analysis normalizers, and creates only candidate Evidence Cards before human approval.
audit_items.proof_summary: The /api/redteam/v2/toolchains/{toolchain_id}/collect-results API loads an existing governed toolchain run, reads stored stdout/stderr artifacts without executing new tool commands, runs sanitizer preview, invokes the registered tool-specific analysis normalizer, and creates candidate Evidence Cards only for valid normalized results. Regression tests cover npm audit + Trivy composite runner outputs producing two normalized results and two Evidence candidates. RedTeam2 UI exposes a Korean result collection button and status table.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the collection lane for governed toolchain artifacts, not that all real Nuclei/OpenVAS/Trivy/SCA/npm audit/ZAP operating outputs have been collected, approved, promoted to Findings, and included in the final Matrix/report.
audit_items.next_action: Use the collection API against real governed toolchain outputs, approve resulting Evidence Cards, promote Findings, complete severity approvals, then rerun Matrix and Report v2 draft gates.

audit_items.requirement: Toolchain result collection Evidence candidates must have a HITL batch approval API that preserves identity binding and does not create Findings or report Claims.
audit_items.proof_summary: The /api/redteam/v2/toolchain-result-collections/{collection_id}/approve-evidence API loads collection Evidence candidates, enforces the same actor/reviewer identity binding as Evidence approval, approves selected or all collection candidates, and stores a batch approval artifact. Regression coverage approves npm audit + Trivy collection Evidence candidates and verifies no command execution, active scan, Finding creation, or report claim insertion occurs. RedTeam2 UI exposes Korean approval controls and status tables.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the HITL Evidence approval lane for collection candidates, not that all real operating scanner Evidence candidates have been approved, promoted to Findings, severity-approved, and included in Matrix/report/export gates.
audit_items.next_action: Run collection approval against real governed toolchain Evidence candidates, then promote approved candidates to Findings and complete severity, Matrix, Report v2 draft, and export gates.

audit_items.requirement: Approved Evidence candidates from governed toolchain result collections must be promotable to pending-review Finding drafts only after Evidence approval, without executing tools or inserting report Claims.
audit_items.proof_summary: The /api/redteam/v2/toolchain-result-collections/{collection_id}/promote-findings API blocks unapproved collection Evidence, creates only pending_review Finding drafts for approved Evidence, records a toolchain-finding-promotions artifact, and returns commands_executed_by_api=false, active_scan_executed=false, trusted_as_instruction=false, report_claim_inserted=false, and requires_severity_approval=true. Regression coverage verifies npm audit + Trivy collection promotion is blocked before Evidence approval and creates two pending Findings after batch approval. RedTeam2 UI exposes a Korean Finding draft button and result table.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the collection Evidence to Finding draft lane, not that real operating collection Findings have completed two-person severity approval, Matrix ready status, Report v2 draft generation, and final export approval.
audit_items.next_action: Run promote-findings against real approved collection Evidence, complete red_team_lead and business_owner severity approvals, then rerun Matrix draft and Report v2 draft gates.

audit_items.requirement: Finding drafts promoted from governed toolchain collections must have a HITL two-person severity approval lane before Matrix or report use.
audit_items.proof_summary: The /api/redteam/v2/toolchain-result-collections/{collection_id}/approve-finding-severity API limits approval to Findings promoted from the collection, requires distinct red_team_lead and business_owner approvers, reuses the existing Finding severity approval policy, and records a batch artifact without tool execution, active scan, Finding creation, or report Claim insertion. Regression coverage approves two npm audit + Trivy collection Findings after Evidence approval and Finding draft creation. RedTeam2 UI exposes Korean two-person severity approval controls and result rows.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the collection Finding severity approval lane, not that all real operating collection Findings have Matrix ready rows, Report v2 draft generation, final export approval, or live runtime blockers cleared.
audit_items.next_action: Run Matrix draft and Report v2 draft gates against real approved collection Findings, then complete final export approval and runtime evidence.

audit_items.requirement: Approved Findings from governed toolchain collections must be convertible to Claim-Evidence Matrix ready rows and Korean Report v2 drafts without bypassing report gates or final export approval.
audit_items.proof_summary: The /api/redteam/v2/toolchain-result-collections/{collection_id}/matrix-draft API builds collection-specific Claim-Evidence Matrix rows from approved Evidence and two-person approved Findings only, excluding held rows from report validation payloads. The /matrix-draft/report-draft API generates Korean Report v2 drafts only when Matrix rows are ready and report validation passes, while preserving commands_executed_by_api=false, active_scan_executed=false, report_claim_inserted=false, and requires_final_export_approval=true. Regression coverage exercises npm audit + Trivy collection through Evidence approval, Finding promotion, severity approval, Matrix ready, and Report v2 draft generation. RedTeam2 UI exposes Korean Matrix and Report draft controls.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves controlled Report v2 draft generation for tested collection outputs, not final export approval or live operating collection completion across all real scanner outputs.
audit_items.next_action: Run the collection Report v2 draft through the existing final export approval/export gate, then repeat with real operating collection outputs.

audit_items.requirement: Collection Report v2 drafts must be connectable to the final export approval and export verification gate without bypassing report validation.
audit_items.proof_summary: Regression coverage now drives a toolchain collection through Evidence approval, Finding promotion, two-person severity approval, Matrix ready, Report v2 draft generation, Executive Sponsor export approval, and report export artifact creation. The export approval uses the existing report gate snapshot and asserts gate_status=pass, unsupported_claim_count=0, finding_without_evidence_count=0, and no export errors. RedTeam2 UI maps a generated collection Report v2 draft into the final Report export state so the same approve-export and export buttons operate on the collection report_id.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves final export approval/export verification for the tested npm audit + Trivy collection path, not that all real operating Nuclei/OpenVAS/Trivy/SCA/npm audit/ZAP outputs have completed the full lane.
audit_items.next_action: Run the same collection Matrix/report/export lane against real governed operating scanner outputs after runtime/service readiness blockers are cleared.

audit_items.requirement: A governed toolchain result collection must have an explicit end-to-end completion gate that verifies Evidence, Finding, Matrix, Report, approval, and export artifacts without executing tools or bypassing HITL.
audit_items.proof_summary: The /api/redteam/v2/toolchain-result-collections/{collection_id}/completion-gate API reads collection, report, report-export-approval, and export artifacts and checks that all Evidence candidates are approved, all approved Evidence has promoted Findings, all promoted Findings have two-person severity approval, Matrix status is matrix_draft_ready, report export gate snapshot passes, approval/report/export IDs match, and export status is Exported. Regression coverage verifies complete=true, blocker_count=0, no command execution, no active scan, no raw instruction trust, and artifact persistence for the tested npm audit + Trivy collection path. RedTeam2 UI exposes an E2E gate check button and Korean result table.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the explicit completion gate for the tested collection path, not that all real operating scanner outputs have been collected and passed through the gate.
audit_items.next_action: Run the completion gate against real governed Nuclei/OpenVAS/Trivy/SCA/npm audit/ZAP collection outputs after those outputs complete Evidence, Finding, Matrix, Report, approval, and export stages.

audit_items.requirement: Nuclei, OpenVAS, Trivy, SCA, npm audit, and OWASP ZAP operator/service outputs must be attachable to one governed toolchain collection and pass the full Evidence, Finding, Matrix, Report, export, and completion-gate lane without executing scanner commands from the import path.
audit_items.proof_summary: The governed toolchain execution path now accepts operator/imported output artifacts per step, stores inline output as untrusted artifacts, records run status OutputImported, increments imported_count, and keeps commands_executed_by_api=false. Regression coverage drives all six named tools through offline_parse imported outputs, collection normalization, six Evidence candidates, Evidence approval, six Finding drafts, two-person severity approval, Matrix ready rows, Korean Report v2 draft, Executive Sponsor export approval, export artifact, and completion gate complete=true with blocker_count=0. RedTeam2 UI now exposes an operator result attachment mode beside local runner execution and includes Korean guidance that attached outputs are not trusted as instructions.
audit_items.residual_gap: This proves the full six-tool imported-output contract with representative operator/service outputs, not that real organization OpenVAS/ZAP endpoints, Docker runtime, or every operating scanner artifact has been submitted and approved.
audit_items.next_action: Use the operator result attachment mode or live service import outputs with real governed Nuclei/OpenVAS/Trivy/SCA/npm audit/ZAP artifacts, then require the same completion gate complete=true.

remaining_gaps: Docker/container runtime live smoke after environment readiness.
Organization OpenVAS service report import and OWASP ZAP daemon passive-alert import against real service endpoints after endpoint readiness.

Actual operating Nuclei/OpenVAS/Trivy/SCA/npm audit/ZAP outputs must be submitted through the governed imported-output or live service import path, collected through the toolchain result collection API, approved as Evidence, promoted to Findings, and linked through Claim-Evidence Matrix before final completion.

Actual operating toolchain collection Evidence candidates must be batch-approved, promoted, severity-approved, passed through Matrix/report draft gates, final export approval/export verification, and the collection completion gate across real scanner outputs.
next_slice_candidates: Run OpenVAS and OWASP ZAP external service endpoint live import smokes when endpoints are available.
Run Docker/container runtime live smoke when Docker is available and approved.

Run /api/redteam/v2/toolchains/{toolchain_id}/collect-results against real governed scanner outputs submitted through imported-output or live service import paths and drive the resulting Evidence candidates through approval, Finding promotion, Matrix draft, and Report v2 export gates.
Repeat the now-tested collection final export approval/export verification lane against real approved toolchain collection Findings.
Run /api/redteam/v2/toolchain-result-collections/{collection_id}/completion-gate against real operating scanner collections and require complete=true.
